name: Ortur Laser Master 3 20W
tagline: Community-favorite open-frame diode : best LM3 value
tldr: The 20W LM3 is the configuration most buyers mean when they say 'Laser Master 3'. Strong engraving, light cutting, huge community : verify you are not accidentally ordering the 10W SKU.

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Community-favorite open-frame diode : best LM3 value
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 400 × 400 mm (15.75 × 15.75 in) on this chassis
Balanced engrave and cut : typical 8 mm basswood in multiple passes
Reference engrave job on this module: ~10–15 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~5–8 min
cons: Verify the 20W SKU : same chassis, different modules
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W module on Ortur Laser Master 3. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.

accessories.note: 450 nm diode : verify OD with seller

mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic
